COST: realized generation contacts against the 15,200 ceiling and the about-6,400 expectation; realized repeated speech seconds against 66,338; realized FIT endpoints against 60,800; GPU hours read from the serving monitor over the lease window, never a wall-clock guess.

Item S3-1k removed the overlap the train-exemplars store contributed by re-pointing it at the release size-pool-annotated-exemplars-minus-r01. The residual intersection was 175 R01 rows whose utterances are card sources of the two AUTHORED semantic stores (intent-boundaries-v1, 57 recordings; slot-contracts-v2, 155 recordings; union 175 utterances), and an authored card cannot be re-pointed model-free. Those rows therefore left the QUERY side.
